Remaining scientific contract

Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P3 optional extension, not a current shared-W0 defect. CompactConditionPreparation explicitly compiles one fixed whitening/mask geometry and whitened nuisance QR/projector. Lag-Gram assembly must therefore qualify the complete voxel-dependent nuisance elimination, response cross-products, rank/projector accuracy and noise/df semantics, not only the task Gram. Require independent direct per-voxel whitened augmented-design solves, run-start/censor-boundary tests, finite-order/coefficient validation and bounded memory/work counters. Preserve the shared-mask restriction and refuse incompatible geometry; do not reuse a shared nuisance projector merely because dimensions match. The proposed O(p^2 K^2) Gram assembly is one cost component, not an end-to-end performance proof. Existing ordinary GLS voxelwise support does not establish this compact-profile capability. No source edits or new mathematical/runtime qualification in this assessment.

Original optional proposal

Precompute `(p+1)(p+2)/2` lag Grams of `A_tilde`; assemble per-voxel Grams in
`O(p^2 K^2)`; lifts the shared-`W0` restriction for the condition regime.
Shared mask restriction stays.

Specification: docs/plans/profile-hrf-work-items-v2.md; architecture: docs/plans/profile-hrf-review.md; scientific plan: docs/plans/profile-hrf.md.
